scenes.title: Gas bill
scenes.caption: A quick look at your Brightwater gas bill.
scenes.say: Got a gas bill from Brightwater Energy? Here's what it says, and the couple of things it asks you to do.

scenes.title: What you used
scenes.caption: 91 days of gas came to £261.15.
scenes.say: It covers 91 days, from early August to early November. You used 3,215 kilowatt hours, and the total comes to two hundred and sixty-one pounds fifteen.

scenes.title: Paid so far
scenes.caption: You paid £180 by Direct Debit.
scenes.say: You have already paid one hundred and eighty pounds by Direct Debit, in three payments of sixty. That leaves less to pay.

scenes.title: Owed now
scenes.caption: The amount now owed is £81.15.
scenes.say: So the amount now owed is this one.

scenes.title: Estimated
scenes.caption: The latest reading was only a guess.
scenes.say: The new meter reading was estimated, not read. Send a real one by 20 November, and they will send a new bill if it differs.

scenes.title: Direct Debit
scenes.caption: Your Direct Debit rises to £87 on 1 December.
scenes.say: Your monthly Direct Debit goes up from sixty pounds to eighty-seven on 1 December, to cover the colder months. If paying is hard, talk to them.

scenes.title: Next steps
scenes.caption: Send a reading by 20 November.
scenes.say: That's it. Send a real reading by 20 November. For payment help, ring the number on your bill, and check the details with Brightwater.
